# Netdata

> Netdata is a distributed, real-time observability platform for metrics, logs and traces. Netdata Agents collect, store and analyze data where it is generated — per second, with machine learning anomaly detection on every metric — and Netdata Parents and Netdata Cloud combine them into one view, without centralizing the data.

This index lists the Netdata documentation on learn.netdata.cloud in sidebar order. The Complete Product Description describes everything Netdata does in one file, with links to the pages below.

## Complete Product Description

- [Complete Product Description](https://learn.netdata.cloud/llms-full.txt): Everything Netdata does in one reference, from architecture, infrastructure, network, databases, logs and OpenTelemetry to cloud, edge, AI, alerting and pricing, with links to the documentation.
- [Complete Product Description web page](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/welcome-to-netdata/complete-product-description)

## Welcome to Netdata

- [Welcome to Netdata](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/welcome-to-netdata)
- [Enterprise Evaluation Guide](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/welcome-to-netdata/enterprise-evaluation-guide): Evaluate Netdata architecture, deployment models, infrastructure requirements, security, integrations, and operational capabilities.
- [Real-time Monitoring](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/welcome-to-netdata/real-time-monitoring): Learn how Netdata delivers one-second collection and sub-two-second visibility without sacrificing fidelity as infrastructure scales.
- [Scalability](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/welcome-to-netdata/scalability): See how Netdata scales from one node to large infrastructures with distributed processing, per-second metrics, and horizontal Parent clusters.
- [Monitor Anything](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/welcome-to-netdata/monitor-anything): Netdata gathers real-time metrics from hundreds of data sources using collectors. Most require zero configuration and are pre-configured out of the box.
- [Fleet Deployment and Configuration Management](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/welcome-to-netdata/fleet-deployment-and-configuration-management)
- [Reporting](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/welcome-to-netdata/reporting): Extract infrastructure insights for stakeholders and BI tools using AI Insights, AI assistants (MCP), Grafana, or data export to Power BI, Tableau, and other analytics platforms.

## Netdata Agent

- [Installation › Linux](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/linux): The kickstart.sh script installs Netdata from source, including all dependencies required to connect to Netdata Cloud, with a single command.

- [Installation › Linux › Static binary Linux Packages](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/linux/static-binary-linux-packages): Users can build the static 64-bit binary package that we ship with every release of the open-source Netdata Agent for debugging or specialize purposes.
- [Installation › Linux › Switch Install Types and Release Channels](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/linux/switch-install-types-and-release-channels)
- [Installation › Linux › Offline systems](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/linux/offline-systems): Install the Netdata Agent on offline/air gapped systems to benefit from real-time, per-second monitoring without connecting to the internet.
- [Installation › Windows](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/windows)
- [Installation › Windows › Switching Install Types and Release Channels](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/windows/switching-install-types-and-release-channels): Guide to choosing and switching between different Netdata Windows installation methods and release channels

- [Installation › Kubernetes](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/kubernetes): Deploy Netdata to monitor a Kubernetes cluster to monitor the health, performance, resource utilization, and application metrics of a Kubernetes cluster in real time.

- [Installation › macOS](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/macos)
- [Installation › FreeBSD](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/freebsd): Install Netdata on FreeBSD to monitor the health and performance of bare metal or VMs with thousands of real-time, per-second metrics.
- [Installation › pfSense](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/pfsense): Install Netdata on pfSense to monitor the health and performance of firewalls with thousands of real-time, per-second metrics.
- [Installation › Synology](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/synology): The Netdata Agent can be installed on AMD64-compatible NAS systems using the 64-bit pre-compiled static binary.
- [Installation › Ansible](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/ansible): Deploy an infrastructure monitoring solution in minutes with the Netdata Agent and Ansible. Use and customize a simple playbook for monitoring as code.
- [Installation › AWS](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/aws): Install Netdata on AWS instances or EKS, then configure network access and cloud-specific monitoring integrations.
- [Installation › Azure](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/azure): Install Netdata on Azure virtual machines, then configure network access and Azure-specific monitoring integrations.
- [Installation › GCP](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/installation/gcp): Install Netdata on Google Cloud instances, then configure VPC access and Google Cloud monitoring integrations.
- [Maintenance](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/maintenance)
- [Maintenance › Service Control](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/maintenance/service-control): Manage the Netdata Agent daemon, load configuration changes, and troubleshoot stuck processes on systemd and non-systemd nodes.
- [Maintenance › Update](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/maintenance/update): If you opted out of automatic updates, you need to update your Netdata Agent to the latest nightly or stable version.
- [Maintenance › Uninstall](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/maintenance/uninstall): If you are no longer interested in using the Netdata Agent, use the self-contained uninstaller to remove all traces of binaries and configuration files.
- [Maintenance › Backup and restore an Agent](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/maintenance/backup-and-restore-an-agent): What actions you need to do to backup and Agent and restore it.

- [Resource Utilization › CPU](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/resource-utilization/cpu)

- [Resource Utilization › Extreme Cardinality Protection](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/resource-utilization/extreme-cardinality-protection): How Netdata limits long-term resource use from short-lived chart instances, and how metadata cleanup affects disk space.
- [Resource Utilization › Impact on Cloud VMs](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/resource-utilization/impact-on-cloud-vms): Recommended VM sizing and the resource impact of running Netdata on cloud VMs (AWS, Azure, GCP).
- [Configuration](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration): Netdata is zero-configuration for most users, but complex infrastructures may require you to tweak some of the Agent's granular settings.
- [Configuration › Dynamic Configuration Manager](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/dynamic-configuration-manager): Create, test, deploy, enable, and disable collector and alert configurations across nodes from the Netdata UI.
- [Configuration › Daemon](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/daemon): The Netdata Agent's daemon is installed preconfigured to collect thousands of metrics every second, but is highly configurable for real-world workloads.
- [Configuration › Database](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/database): With a single configuration change, the Netdata Agent can store days, weeks, or months of metrics at its famous per-second granularity.
- [Configuration › Registry](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/registry): Configure a private Netdata Registry, access controls, retention, cookies, and Agent settings for cross-server dashboards.
- [Configuration › Securing Agents](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/securing-agents): Your data and systems are safe with Netdata, but we recommend a few easy ways to improve the security of your infrastructure.
- [Configuration › Securing Agents › Web Server Reference](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/securing-agents/web-server-reference): The Netdata Agent's local static-threaded web server serves dashboards and real-time visualizations with security and DDoS protection.
- [Configuration › Securing Agents › Bearer Token Protection](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/securing-agents/bearer-token-protection)
- [Configuration › Securing Agents › Configure Netdata for cybersecurity platforms](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/securing-agents/configure-netdata-for-cybersecurity-platforms): Configure Netdata behind cybersecurity platforms such as Sophos, reverse proxies, firewalls, and secure-access gateways.
- [Configuration › Securing Agents › Running the Agent behind a reverse proxy](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/securing-agents/running-the-agent-behind-a-reverse-proxy)
- [Configuration › Securing Agents › Running the Agent behind a reverse proxy › Nginx](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/netdata-agent/configuration/securing-agents/running-the-agent-behind-a-reverse-proxy/nginx)

## Exporting Metrics

- [Exporting Metrics](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/exporting-metrics): Use the exporting engine to send Netdata metrics to popular external time series databases for long-term storage or further analysis.
- [Exporting reference](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/exporting-metrics/exporting-reference): With the exporting engine, you can archive your Netdata metrics to multiple external databases for long-term storage or further analysis.
- [Enable an exporting connector](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/exporting-metrics/enable-an-exporting-connector): Learn how to enable and configure any connector using examples to start exporting metrics to external time-series databases in minutes.
- [Prometheus](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/exporting-metrics/prometheus): Export Netdata metrics to Prometheus for archiving and further analysis.
- [Shell Scripts](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/exporting-metrics/shell-scripts)
- [Connectors](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/exporting-metrics/connectors): Browse Netdata integrations for Exporting Metrics / Connectors and open the setup documentation for each supported technology.

## Network Performance Monitoring

- [Network Performance Monitoring](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring): Monitor your whole network from one Agent per site — devices, topology, flows, traps, and logs, unified in Netdata Cloud.
- [Device Metrics](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/device-metrics): Poll routers, switches, firewalls, and other devices over SNMP with the Netdata Agent.
- [Device Metrics › Quick Start](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/device-metrics/quick-start): Get one device polling and auto-detected in a few minutes.
- [Device Metrics › Configuration](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/device-metrics/configuration): Credentials, SNMPv3, multiple devices, and the polling options.
- [Device Metrics › Configuration › SNMP Profile Format](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/device-metrics/configuration/snmp-profile-format): Learn how Netdata’s SNMP collector uses profiles.
- [Device Metrics › Sizing and Scaling](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/device-metrics/sizing-and-scaling): How many devices one Agent should poll, and how to scale with hubs and Parents.
- [Device Metrics › Validation](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/device-metrics/validation): Confirm profile match, 64-bit counters, and clean polling before you trust the data.
- [Device Metrics › Troubleshooting](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/device-metrics/troubleshooting): Timeouts, missing metrics, SNMPv3 auth, gaps, and phantom spikes.
- [Device Metrics › Collect Troubleshooting Data](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/device-metrics/collect-troubleshooting-data): Include built-in SNMP diagnostics in a private support bundle for metrics, BGP, licensing, and topology issues.
- [Device Metrics › Anti-patterns](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/device-metrics/anti-patterns): The common SNMP polling mistakes and how to avoid them.
- [Device Metrics › Integrations](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/device-metrics/integrations): Browse Netdata integrations for Device Metrics / Integrations and open the setup documentation for each supported technology.
- [Licensing Monitoring](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/licensing-monitoring): Track license state and expiry across your network devices before a feature silently stops.
- [Licensing Monitoring › Metrics and Functions](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/licensing-monitoring/metrics-and-functions): The snmp.license.* charts and the snmp:licenses function.
- [Licensing Monitoring › Integrations](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/licensing-monitoring/integrations): Browse Netdata integrations for Licensing Monitoring / Integrations and open the setup documentation for each supported technology.
- [Topologies](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/topologies): See how your infrastructure is connected — Layer 2 and Layer 3 device topology, application dependencies, and virtual infrastructure.
- [Topologies › Discovery Methods](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/topologies/discovery-methods): What LLDP, CDP, FDB, ARP, STP, BGP, and OSPF each contribute to the map.
- [Topologies › Application Dependency Mapping](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/topologies/application-dependency-mapping): Which process, container, and Kubernetes workload talks to which, read from the kernel with no instrumentation.
- [Topologies › Integrations](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/topologies/integrations): Browse Netdata integrations for Topologies / Integrations and open the setup documentation for each supported technology.
- [BGP Monitoring](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/bgp-monitoring): Monitor BGP peer state, prefixes, and session health on your routers.
- [BGP Monitoring › Metrics and Functions](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/bgp-monitoring/metrics-and-functions): The snmp.bgp.* charts and the snmp:bgp-peers function.
- [BGP Monitoring › Integrations](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/bgp-monitoring/integrations): Browse Netdata integrations for BGP Monitoring / Integrations and open the setup documentation for each supported technology.
- [Network Flows](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows): Collect, enrich, and visualize NetFlow, IPFIX, and sFlow data with the Netdata Agent.
- [Network Flows › Installation](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/installation)
- [Network Flows › Quick Start](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/quick-start): Get network flow monitoring running in five minutes.
- [Network Flows › Configuration](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/configuration): Full reference for netflow.yaml configuration options.
- [Network Flows › Enrichment](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/enrichment): Order of evaluation, provider chains, MMDB shared mechanism, and the cross-cutting properties that span every enrichment method.
- [Network Flows › Enrichment Intel Downloader](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/enrichment-intel-downloader): The bundled tool that fetches IP intelligence data sources and writes MMDB files the netflow plugin reads.
- [Network Flows › Field Reference](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/field-reference): Complete list of flow fields with per-protocol availability.
- [Network Flows › Visualization](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/visualization): How queries work, the controls every panel shares, and where each panel fits.
- [Network Flows › Visualization › Sankey and Table](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/visualization/sankey-and-table)
- [Network Flows › Visualization › Time-Series](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/visualization/time-series)
- [Network Flows › Visualization › Maps and Globe](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/visualization/maps-and-globe)
- [Network Flows › Visualization › Filters and Facets](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/visualization/filters-and-facets)
- [Network Flows › Visualization › Plugin Health Charts](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/visualization/plugin-health-charts)
- [Network Flows › Retention and Tiers](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/retention-and-tiers)
- [Network Flows › Sizing and Capacity Planning](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/sizing-and-capacity-planning): Practical scaling guide -- plugin cap, storage, memory, and distributed deployment.
- [Network Flows › Validation and Data Quality](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/validation-and-data-quality)
- [Network Flows › Investigation Playbooks](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/investigation-playbooks)
- [Network Flows › Anti-patterns](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/anti-patterns)
- [Network Flows › Troubleshooting](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/troubleshooting)

- [Network Flows › Flow Protocols](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/network-flows/flow-protocols): Browse Netdata integrations for Network Flows / Flow Protocols and open the setup documentation for each supported technology.
- [SNMP Traps](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps): Receive, decode, store, query, and forward SNMP Trap and INFORM events with the Netdata Agent.
- [SNMP Traps › Installation](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/installation)
- [SNMP Traps › Quick Start](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/quick-start): Configure a listener, send a test trap, and prove Netdata received it.
- [SNMP Traps › Configuration](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/configuration): Configure listener endpoints, SNMP versions, source controls, storage, forwarding, deduplication, and profile metrics.
- [SNMP Traps › Trap Profiles](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/trap-profiles): Understand stock trap coverage, custom profiles, overrides, MIB conversion, and profile-defined metrics.
- [SNMP Traps › SNMP Trap Profile Format](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/snmp-trap-profile-format): Reference for SNMP trap profile YAML, trap definitions, varbind metadata, rendering, and profile metric rules.
- [SNMP Traps › Enrichment](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/enrichment): Understand source identity, trusted relays, reverse DNS, device identity, interface context, and enrichment audit fields.
- [SNMP Traps › Usage and Output](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/usage-and-output): Read normal trap rows, decode errors, deduplication summaries, varbinds, tags, and payload fields.
- [SNMP Traps › Field Reference](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/field-reference): Complete reference for journal fields, report types, enrichment fields, varbind fields, tags, and OTLP mappings.
- [SNMP Traps › Journal and Querying](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/journal-and-querying): Query, export, copy, and inspect direct-journal trap data with Netdata Logs and journalctl-compatible workflows.
- [SNMP Traps › Forwarding to SIEM](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/forwarding-to-siem): Forward trap events through journal-native workflows or OTLP/gRPC and map fields in downstream log systems.
- [SNMP Traps › Metrics](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/metrics): Read receiver pipeline health, severity and category rates, processing errors, deduplication, and optional profile-defined metrics.
- [SNMP Traps › Alerts](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/alerts): Understand, route, and silence the default SNMP trap health alerts.
- [SNMP Traps › Sizing and Capacity Planning](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/sizing-and-capacity-planning): Plan receiver capacity, output backends, retention, storm controls, profile metrics, source visibility, and validation.
- [SNMP Traps › Validation and Data Quality](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/validation-and-data-quality): Prove first receipt, source identity, profile coverage, enrichment quality, backend health, retention, and downstream fields.
- [SNMP Traps › Investigation Playbooks](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/investigation-playbooks): Follow operator playbooks for storms, critical traps, interface changes, restart signals, missing traps, unknown OIDs, SNMPv3 failures, and forwarding checks.
- [SNMP Traps › Anti-patterns](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/anti-patterns): Avoid unsafe listeners, broad relay trust, inline secrets, high-cardinality metrics, noisy alerting, and storage blind spots.
- [SNMP Traps › Troubleshooting](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/troubleshooting): Diagnose missing rows, inactive listeners, UDP delivery, allowlist drops, SNMPv3 failures, profile issues, backend failures, and retention problems.
- [SNMP Traps › Integrations](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/snmp-traps/integrations): Browse Netdata integrations for SNMP Traps / Integrations and open the setup documentation for each supported technology.
- [Syslog](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/network-performance-monitoring/syslog): Where syslog ingestion is documented — through an OpenTelemetry Collector into Netdata's log store, next to the devices' SNMP metrics, traps, and flows.

## Logs Management

- [Logs Management](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management): Logs management with Netdata — ingestion, storage, indexing, and querying of logs from native OS stores, text files, and OpenTelemetry, distributed or centralized.
- [Managing Logs](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/managing-logs): How logs are organized, stored, queried, and explored in Netdata — sources, field filters with counters, full-text search, histograms, live tail, and sampling at scale.
- [Windows Event Logs](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/windows-event-logs): View, explore and analyze Windows event channels from the Netdata dashboard, including forwarded-events channels on a Windows Event Collector.
- [macOS Unified Logs](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/macos-unified-logs): View, explore and analyze the macOS unified log from the Netdata dashboard.
- [SNMP Trap Logs](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/snmp-trap-logs): SNMP traps as journal-compatible files written by Netdata — where they are stored, how they are queried in the Logs tab and with journalctl, and where the collector is documented.
- [Network Flows](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/network-flows): NetFlow, sFlow, and IPFIX flows as journal-compatible files written by Netdata — the four storage tiers, retention, journalctl access, and where the plugin is documented.
- [Text Files to Journals](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/text-files-to-journals): Bring application text log files under Netdata logs management — convert them to structured journal entries with log2journal, or ship them as OpenTelemetry logs, and when each path is the right one.
- [Text Files to Journals › log2journal](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/text-files-to-journals/log2journal)
- [Text Files to Journals › systemd-cat-native](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/text-files-to-journals/systemd-cat-native)
- [Centralizing Logs with OpenTelemetry](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/centralizing-logs-with-opentelemetry): When to centralize a log source into Netdata's log store with OpenTelemetry, and the two things to set up — the receiving Agent and the Collector recipes per source.
- [Log Storage and Retention](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/log-storage-and-retention): Control what logs cost — journald disk limits and namespaces, Windows event channel sizing, Netdata's log store retention, and offloading to object storage.
- [Integrations](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/integrations): Browse Netdata integrations for Logs Management / Integrations and open the setup documentation for each supported technology.
- [Systemd Journal Logs › Systemd Journal Plugin Reference](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/systemd-journal-logs/systemd-journal-plugin-reference): View and analyze logs available in systemd journal
- [Systemd Journal Logs › Forward Secure Sealing (FSS) in Systemd-Journal](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/systemd-journal-logs/forward-secure-sealing-fss-in-systemd-journal)
- [Systemd Journal Logs › Logs Centralization Points](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/systemd-journal-logs/logs-centralization-points)
- [Systemd Journal Logs › Logs Centralization Points › Passive journal centralization with encryption using self-signed certificates](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/systemd-journal-logs/logs-centralization-points/passive-journal-centralization-with-encryption-using-self-signed-certificates)
- [Systemd Journal Logs › Logs Centralization Points › Passive journal centralization without encryption](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/systemd-journal-logs/logs-centralization-points/passive-journal-centralization-without-encryption)
- [Systemd Journal Logs › Logs Centralization Points › Active journal source without encryption](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/systemd-journal-logs/logs-centralization-points/active-journal-source-without-encryption)
- [Systemd Journal Logs › Logs Centralization Points › Centralizing Journal Namespaces](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/logs-management/systemd-journal-logs/logs-centralization-points/centralizing-journal-namespaces): Forward per-namespace systemd-journal logs to a central systemd-journal-remote server, including on systemd versions prior to 254.

## OpenTelemetry

- [OpenTelemetry](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry): The Netdata Agent as an OTLP receiver over gRPC and HTTP — metrics become charts, logs and traces are stored indexed on the Agent, with TLS and Collector recipes.
- [OTLP Ingestion](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/otlp-ingestion): Export metrics, logs, and traces from an OpenTelemetry Collector to a Netdata Agent
- [Securing the OTLP Endpoint](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/securing-the-otlp-endpoint): Bind the OTLP endpoint safely — loopback by default, TLS and mutual TLS for remote senders, network controls, certificate rotation, and what reaches Netdata Cloud.
- [Metrics Collection](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/metrics-collection): Collect Prometheus, Redis, NGINX, PostgreSQL, and host metrics through OpenTelemetry Collector receivers
- [Logs Collection](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/logs-collection): Collect systemd journal, application file, Windows event channel, Kubernetes container, macOS unified log, and syslog records through OpenTelemetry Collector receivers
- [Transformations](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/transformations): Parse, enrich, normalize, and filter OpenTelemetry logs before exporting them to Netdata
- [Logs-to-Metrics](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/logs-to-metrics): Count matching OpenTelemetry log records and chart their rate in Netdata
- [Trace Storage and Retention](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/trace-storage-and-retention): How the Netdata Agent stores OpenTelemetry traces — retention, offloading to object storage with read-back, and sizing the receiving node.
- [Syslog from Network Devices](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/syslog-from-network-devices): Ingest syslog from network devices through the OpenTelemetry Collector and explore it in the Logs tab.
- [Syslog from Network Devices › OpenTelemetry Collector Setup](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/syslog-from-network-devices/opentelemetry-collector-setup): A working syslog receiver configuration and how to make it durable.
- [Syslog from Network Devices › Integrations](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/syslog-from-network-devices/integrations): Browse Netdata integrations for Syslog from Network Devices / Integrations and open the setup documentation for each supported technology.
- [OpenTelemetry Plugin Reference](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/opentelemetry/opentelemetry-plugin-reference): Ingest OpenTelemetry metrics, logs, and traces with the Netdata Agent.

- [Netdata Cloud](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/security-and-privacy-design/netdata-cloud): Learn how Netdata Cloud secures metadata, live metric access, authentication, authorization, communications, and infrastructure.

## Developer and Contributor Corner

- [Developer and Contributor Corner](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner)
- [Netdata Support Bundle](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/netdata-support-bundle): Collect a sanitized diagnostics archive from a Netdata Agent and attach it to a support ticket or bug report.
- [REST API](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api)
- [REST API › Queries](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries)
- [REST API › Queries › Average or Mean](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/average-or-mean)
- [REST API › Queries › CountIf](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/countif)
- [REST API › Queries › Double exponential smoothing](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/double-exponential-smoothing)
- [REST API › Queries › Incremental Sum (`incremental_sum`)](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/incremental-sum-incremental_sum)
- [REST API › Queries › Max](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/max)
- [REST API › Queries › Median](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/median): Use median in API queries and health entities to find the 'middle' value from a sample, eliminating any unwanted spikes in the returned metrics.
- [REST API › Queries › Min](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/min)
- [REST API › Queries › Percentile](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/percentile): Use percentile in API queries and health entities to find the 'percentile' value from a sample, eliminating any unwanted spikes in the returned metrics.
- [REST API › Queries › Single (or Simple) Exponential Smoothing (`ses`)](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/single-or-simple-exponential-smoothing-ses)
- [REST API › Queries › Standard deviation (`stddev`)](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/standard-deviation-stddev)
- [REST API › Queries › Sum](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/sum)
- [REST API › Queries › Trimmed Mean](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/queries/trimmed-mean): Use trimmed-mean in API queries and health entities to find the average value from a sample, eliminating any unwanted spikes in the returned metrics.
- [REST API › Formatters](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/formatters)
- [REST API › Formatters › CSV formatter](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/formatters/csv-formatter): Format Netdata metric query results as CSV, TSV, HTML, Markdown tables, or JSON arrays with supported data options.
- [REST API › Formatters › JSON formatter](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/rest-api/formatters/json-formatter): Format Netdata metric query results as JSON, JSONP, Google DataTable, or DataSource responses with supported options.

- [Build the Netdata Agent Yourself › How to build native (DEB/RPM) packages locally for testing](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/build-the-netdata-agent-yourself/how-to-build-native-deb-rpm-packages-locally-for-testing): Instructions for developers who need to build native packages locally for testing.
- [Install the Netdata Agent from a Git checkout](https://learn.netdata.cloud/docs/developer-and-contributor-corner/install-the-netdata-agent-from-a-git-checkout): Use the Netdata Agent source code from GitHub, plus helper scripts to set up your system, to install Netdata without packages or binaries.
